collection.title: Food Grade Silicone Feeders for Babies & Toddlers
collection.body_html:
Food Grade Silicone Feeders

Food grade silicone feeders provide a safe, hygienic solution for introducing solid foods to infants and toddlers. Made from 100% food-safe silicone that meets FDA and CPSIA standards, these feeders allow babies to explore new tastes and textures while minimizing choking hazards.

Our silicone feeder collection features BPA-free, phthalate-free materials that withstand repeated sterilization and dishwasher cleaning. The soft, flexible silicone is gentle on sensitive gums while being durable enough for daily use during the weaning process.

Benefits of Silicone Baby Feeders

  • Non-toxic, medical-grade silicone construction
  • Heat-resistant up to 230°C for safe sterilization
  • Easy-grip handles designed for small hands
  • Prevents choking while allowing self-feeding
  • Dishwasher and freezer safe
  • Stain and odor resistant material

These feeders work with fresh fruits, frozen teething foods, purees, and soft cooked vegetables. The silicone construction eliminates concerns about mesh fraying or metal components, making them a long-lasting choice for multiple children.

Suitable for babies 4 months and older beginning their solid food journey, food grade silicone feeders support independent eating skills and oral motor development.

products.title: Baby Fruit Feeder Pacifier – BPA-Free Silicone Teether for Infants
products.body_html:
Safe Silicone Baby Fruit Feeder Pacifier

The LuvCub Baby Fruit Feeder provides a safe way to introduce fresh fruits, vegetables, and soft foods to your infant. Made from BPA-free, food-grade silicone, this feeder pacifier eliminates choking hazards while allowing babies to explore new flavors and textures independently.

BPA-Free Silicone Construction

Crafted from non-toxic, food-grade silicone material that meets safety standards for infant products. The durable construction withstands repeated use and cleaning while remaining gentle on delicate gums.

Anti-Choke Design for Safe Feeding

The soft silicone nipple features small perforations that allow only tiny, manageable pieces of food through. This anti-choke design lets infants taste and enjoy solid foods safely during the weaning process. Parents can confidently introduce bananas, strawberries, melons, cooked vegetables, and other nutritious foods without constant supervision.

Dual-Purpose Teether Function

Beyond feeding, the soft silicone nipple doubles as a soothing teether for babies experiencing teething discomfort. The textured surface provides relief for sore gums while encouraging healthy oral development. Chill the feeder in the refrigerator for added cooling relief during teething episodes.

Easy-Grip Handle for Self-Feeding

The ergonomic handle design allows little hands to grip and hold the feeder independently. This promotes self-feeding skills and hand-eye coordination as infants learn to bring food to their mouths. The lightweight construction prevents fatigue during extended feeding sessions.

Simple Cleaning and Maintenance

The feeder disassembles completely for thorough cleaning. All components are dishwasher safe for convenient sanitization between uses. The silicone material resists staining and odor absorption, maintaining hygiene standards meal after meal.

Key Features:

  • Safe Silicone Material: BPA-free and non-toxic.
  • Multi-Use Feeder: Works with fruits, veggies, and purees.
  • Teether Function: Soothes sore gums during teething.
  • Anti-Choke Design: Safe and comfortable feeding.
  • Easy to Hold & Clean: Child-friendly grip and dishwasher safe.

The LuvCub Baby Fruit Feeder Pacifier supports nutritional supplementation during the transition to solid foods while reducing mealtime fussiness.

Baby Rice Cereal Feeding Bottle with Silicone Spoon Feeder

The Luxora Baby Rice Cereal Feeding Bottle simplifies the transition to solid foods for infants. Crafted from premium food-grade silicone, this feeder is safe, BPA-free, soft, and gentle on delicate gums, making it ideal for babies starting their complementary feeding journey.

The spoon feeder design allows you to fill the bottle with milk, rice cereal, or pureed baby food, then gently squeeze for smooth, mess-free feeding. Perfect for complementary foods, it helps babies learn independent eating while reducing spills. The squeeze-to-dispense mechanism gives parents full control over portion sizes and feeding pace.

Safe Materials for Your Baby

Made with food-grade silicone that's completely BPA-free, this feeding bottle prioritizes your baby's health and safety. The soft silicone spoon tip is gentle on sensitive gums, making it comfortable for babies who are teething or just beginning to explore solid textures.

Portable & Travel-Ready

Compact and portable, this feeder is ideal for both home and travel use, ensuring your baby enjoys nutritious meals anywhere. Whether you're visiting grandparents, dining out, or traveling, this lightweight feeder fits easily in diaper bags and keeps feeding time stress-free on the go.

Key Features

  • Safe & BPA-Free: Made with food-grade silicone, gentle for babies.

  • 2-in-1 Design: Combines bottle + spoon feeder for mess-free feeding.

  • Easy to Use: Squeeze design dispenses cereal or puree smoothly.

  • Portable & Travel-Friendly: Lightweight for easy feeding on the go.
